title: How Gil composes at the piano
summary: Gil says he hears the orchestra when he plays the piano, using it to work out inner voices.

story.theme_name: Writing and arranging: how musicians compose
story.community_name: Writing, arranging and composing: how the music gets made

blocks.x: Your hitting the piano just now brings something else into my mind and that is of your creating at the piano. Now do you actually play out all of your melodies or do you work with the harmony, do you play out all of the various parts for the instruments? Would you talk about that a little bit? How you actually go about creating at the piano.

Well the piano has become kind of neutral for me in a way, you know. I hear the orchestra when I play it rather than the piano. So you know, in a sense, I always hear instruments. So I've always used it for, I've always had to play it though in order to hear it for some reason. You know, I've always had to play it in order to make a certain adjustments if you know what I mean.
Inner voices and things that will give it the kind of attention that I want.
Because I know that some composers simply do not work at the piano.
Yes, you really, I can see where you really don't have to. I can do it every primitively anything but anything complicated I use the piano. Some people don't have to at all.
And you work out all of the various parts on the piano? For the various instruments?
Well, if they are all played together for example. If it's an ensemble and they are all playing different notes I would (I work them all at the piano?).
